title: Legal Tender
scope: Canonical card, book, print, QR and site release

sources.title: IMF mission concluding statement
sources.notes: Confirms first-country September 7 adoption, dollar unit of account, Chivo dual-currency operation, conversion mechanism and staff assessment of inclusion and risks.

sources.title: IMF Country Report 22/20
sources.notes: Historical alongside-dollar legal-tender framework. June law passage is separate from September implementation. Report is not used as current legal guidance.

claims.text: First country to adopt Bitcoin as legal tender on September 7, 2021
Dollar remained national accounting unit; Chivo supported dollars and Bitcoin with conversion
IMF staff saw inclusion potential and warned of volatility-related risks
Pupuseria, people and payment are fictional; flag, calendar, cashbox and blank notebook are visible

editorial_guards: No claim current legal rules are unchanged
Do not claim universal enthusiasm or successful transaction
No real person or business identified
Notebook has no legible prices or conversion calculation
Do not include decree number or 2025 US reserve crossover
